'''H'nemthe''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

H'nemthe was a forested [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and home to a reptilian [[Species/Legends|species]] also called H'nemthe. During the season of [[trine]], all three of the planet's moons give off their light. On average, there were twenty H'nemthe males for every female&mdash;after mating, the male was gutted with the female's razor-sharp tongue. Virgin females were not often allowed to leave the planet, and were permitted to eat only fruits and vegetables. Plant life on H'nemthe included the carnivorous [[M'iiyoom]], a white flower which bloomed during the season of trine.

The planet remained unaligned through much of its history. The world was [[Invasion of H'nemthe|invaded]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], forcing many H'nemthe to abandon their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="CCG-H'nemthe">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=H'nemthe}}</ref> Eventually, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] made diplomatic overtures to its government only shortly before the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Second Corellian Insurrection]].
